Küster Anselm steht wieder am Tor, graue: Sexton Anselm is back at the gate, greyer than before. After three nights in a cell they let him go: the ledger proved he had sold grave goods, but nothing against Hester. "You again. Have you come about the grave? Or about the girl nobody is looking for any more?"
Auf einem Kohlekahn am Kai sitzt ein Jun:
On a coal barge at the quay sits a boy in a cap that is too big for him, eating a herring like an apple. Kit. From Kettlegate.

"Well, celebrity? Price had me by the collar back then because of you. Two weeks in a cell, and after that Kettlegate was too small for me. No hard feelings. Almost none."
Nan sagt, auf Briefe an Erwachsene gehör: Nan says letters to grown-ups are addressed formally. So I am writing to you. My doll now has a bed made of four boards. The fifth board is missing, so she slips through at night. Nan also says I should use a box. But the box smells of soap, and I don't want a bed somebody threw away before. Can you write and tell me whether a piece of cloth is enough for a bottom? I can sew myself if someone shows me how to start. Please don't send a big new doll. Mine already knows the missing spot and fits exactly between the boards.
Der Stoff hält. Ich habe ihn dreimal ang: The cloth holds. I sewed it on three times because the first seam looked like a staircase. Now the doll sleeps crosswise. That isn't a rule, just her best position. Another child wants the bed. I said she may look at it. She says sharing means giving away. Is that true? The house mother said I should answer myself. So I am asking you first. If I help build a second bed, is that sharing too? Four new boards are already waiting. This time I looked for a bottom before starting on the sides.
Unter der Berichtigung steht Pip. Der Se: Under the correction it says Pip. The typesetter thought the name too short for the line. I thought it long enough for my mistake. The woman can open her door again without having to confirm her own return. I now deliver her the paper with the print facing inward. Today there is rain, coal prices and a lost glove. Not a good edition, says my boss. A boring edition suits me, as long as I don't have to lie anyone into it. If you write to me, I will mark the envelope private. That is new for me. I am still practising actually respecting the mark.
Du zerstörst die Bindung. Harrow stirbt,: You destroy the binding. Harrow dies, and the dammed-up surge reaches the prepared evacuation. You renounce Sequence 1; the dry exit is a task, not a picture of victory. This is final: Sequence 1 stays sealed forever afterwards, for every one of you.
Ihr teilt die Last und bindet euch beide: You share the burden and bind yourselves both to Varrowmouth. No one ascends to Sequence 1. You hold the names open together without taking it as permission for new entries. This is final: Sequence 1 stays sealed forever afterwards, for every one of you.
Der gewählte Ausgang bleibt bestehen. Se: The chosen outcome stands. Sequence 1 is sealed forever: no trial, no ritual, no potion will open it again.
Du hast in Varrowmouth auf die erste Seq: In Varrowmouth you renounced the first Sequence. This path is sealed forever.
